raw_text: Night protests reported in Tehran neighbourhoods of Sadeghieh and Ekbatan. People chanting from rooftops and balconies. Basij motorcycles patrolling streets. Several arrests confirmed in Sanandaj where Mahsa Amini was from. Revolutionary Guard warning of severe consequences for protesters.
